name: tessera
description: One mod for Claude Code, Windows and CJK first: pasted-image and text previews in any terminal, themed replies with CJK-correct tables and charts, unfinished tasks carried into the next session, and guards for multi-agent runs and Traditional Chinese writing

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Draw replies with this mod. Off falls back to Claude Code's own renderer.

foldDiffs.title: Fold long diffs
foldDiffs.description: An Edit or Write result over 12 diff lines shows up to 8 of them (the first removed and the first added), the added and removed counts, and an expand button. Display only: what Claude reads is unchanged. ctrl+o and --verbose show it whole.

pastePreview.title: Paste previews
pastePreview.description: Pasted images as thumbnails and pasted text the editor collapses to [Pasted text #n] as its first lines, above the prompt. Off: no polling of the prompt box at all.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of tessera's own words (buttons, toasts, /tessera). auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then LC_ALL / LANG, then the system locale; any Chinese reads Traditional Chinese.

replyLanguage.title: Reply in my language
replyLanguage.description: auto: when your own words (not pasted code, logs, quotes or chat lines) are Chinese, Japanese or Korean, ask Claude to reply in that language. off: leave replies alone.

imageMode.title: Image previews
imageMode.description: How pasted images preview above the prompt. auto: real pixels in terminals with kitty graphics (kitty, Ghostty), cell art everywhere else. pixels: always real pixels. cells: always cell art.

thumbnailSize.title: Preview size
thumbnailSize.description: Largest preview box: small (28x8 cells), medium (40x12), large (64x20).

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Base palette, from popular MIT-licensed themes. Light variants: catppuccin-latte, gruvbox-light, rose-pine-dawn, github-light, solarized-light. mono uses bold and dim only.

headingStyle.title: Heading style
headingStyle.description: Terminals have one font size, so headings get weight instead: banner (a box around H1, a heavy rule under H2), bold, underline, or uppercase H1.

tableStyle.title: Table style
tableStyle.description: box: every cell boxed, with a double line under the header. rules: a rule under the header and between rows. grid: heavier header rule, wider gaps. minimal: header rule only.

promptStyle.title: Your prompt style
promptStyle.description: How the prompts you type draw in the transcript. bubble: a rounded box in the accent color. bar: an accent bar on the left. chevron: a bold accent › before the text. off: Claude Code's own look.

toolStyle.title: Tool row style
toolStyle.description: How tool rows (Ran, Read, Edited) sit next to Claude's sentences. chat: tool rows dimmed on the right, Claude on the left. tree-dim: tucked under the sentence with ⎿ and dimmed. tree-bold: tree-dim plus one-line sentences in bold. classic: the original look.

taskStyle.title: Task list style
taskStyle.description: How - [ ] and - [x] items draw. checks: [ ] and [✓] with done items dimmed and struck through. ticks: ○ and ✓, done items dimmed. box: □ and ✓, done items dimmed and struck through. progress: ticks with a done-count bar above each list.

rtl.title: Right-to-left terminal
rtl.description: Hebrew and Arabic get a right-to-left layout (right aligned, bullets and quote bars on the right, tables mirrored), with the letters sent the way your terminal needs them. auto detects the terminal; pick one to force its handling, or off for none.

highlightNumbers.title: Highlight numbers
highlightNumbers.description: Color versions, IDs, counts and durations in prose and tables.

accentColor.title: Accent
accentColor.description: Color for the reply bullet, H3+ headings and quote bars. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

headingColor.title: Heading
headingColor.description: Color for H1 and H2 headings. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

tableHeaderColor.title: Table header
tableHeaderColor.description: Color for table header cells. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

tableRuleColor.title: Table rule
tableRuleColor.description: Color for table rules. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

numberColor.title: Numbers
numberColor.description: Color for versions, IDs and counts. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

pathColor.title: Paths
pathColor.description: Color for file paths. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

linkColor.title: Links
linkColor.description: Color for links and URLs. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

inlineCodeColor.title: Inline code
inlineCodeColor.description: Color for `inline code`. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

codeCommandColor.title: Code command
codeCommandColor.description: Color for the command word in shell blocks. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

codeFlagColor.title: Code flag
codeFlagColor.description: Color for --flags in shell blocks. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

codeStringColor.title: Code string
codeStringColor.description: Color for quoted strings in shell blocks. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

strongColor.title: Bold text
strongColor.description: Color for **bold** text. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

quoteColor.title: Quote
quoteColor.description: Color for block quotes. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.

mermaidAscii.title: Mermaid ASCII only
mermaidAscii.description: Draw diagrams with + - | > instead of box-drawing characters, for fonts without them.

diagramColor.title: Diagram lines
diagramColor.description: Color for diagram boxes and arrows. Hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a name. Empty uses the theme.

diagramTextColor.title: Diagram text
diagramTextColor.description: Color for diagram labels. Hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a name. Empty uses the theme.

toolRows.title: Tool rows
toolRows.description: Draw tool calls as one compact line: Ran gh pr view 12, Read ~/src/app.ts, Edited README.md. Results still draw below as usual.

emphasisColor.title: Italic text
emphasisColor.description: Color for *italic* text. Hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a name. Empty uses the theme.

codeTextColor.title: Code text
codeTextColor.description: Color for code block text. Hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a name. Empty uses the theme.

codeCommentColor.title: Code comment
codeCommentColor.description: Color for # comments in shell blocks. Hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a name. Empty uses the theme.

ruleColor.title: Rules
ruleColor.description: Color for horizontal rules and heading banners. Hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a name. Empty uses the theme.

bulletColor.title: Bullets
bulletColor.description: Color for list bullets and numbers. Hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a name. Empty uses the theme.

mermaid.title: Mermaid diagrams
mermaid.description: Draw ```mermaid blocks as colored box art sized to the terminal. Off leaves the code as written.

copyButtons.title: Copy buttons
copyButtons.description: Put a copy button on code blocks, tables, diagrams, lists and quotes. Reach them with ctrl+x tab then Enter, or click where the terminal passes clicks through.

diagramHints.title: Diagram hints
diagramHints.description: Attach a short note, read by the model and never shown, to each prompt you type, saying tables, code, mermaid diagrams and charts render here. About 190 tokens per prompt. Off when mermaid is off.

guardGit.title: Guard the shared tree
guardGit.description: Refuse a recursive delete (rm -r, Remove-Item -Recurse, rmdir /s, git worktree remove) whose target holds a junction or symlink, and junctions or symlinks to node_modules; remind once before a force push (--force, -f, --force-with-lease, +refspec) to main or master, letting the same command through when sent again; while agents work, also refuse git checkout/switch/reset/restore/stash/clean -f and git add -A / commit -a in the main working tree.

agentModel.title: Model for agents
agentModel.description: Agents that name no model run on the session's model. auto: Haiku reads the task and fills in haiku, sonnet, opus or fable for a general-purpose agent (agent types with their own model are left alone), with a toast naming the pick. choose: refuse those calls and ask Claude for a model. opus, sonnet, haiku or fable: fill that model in. off: leave models alone. Workflow scripts cannot be filled in: auto reminds Claude once to name a model for each agent(), choose refuses until it does.

requireUserQuote.title: Workflows quote you
requireUserQuote.description: Refuse a Workflow whose script carries none of your own words verbatim, so its agents keep your standing instruction even after a later status question.

feedbackInbox.title: Client feedback inbox
feedbackInbox.description: Off by default. When on, a pasted chat log with timestamped lines (22:55 Name message) is filed as numbered items per repository; a new complaint that resembles an item marked fixed is flagged as a likely regression, to you and to Claude. /tessera inbox lists them.

guardCjkEscapes.title: Guard CJK escapes
guardCjkEscapes.description: Refuse tool calls that write Korean, Chinese or Japanese as \uXXXX escapes in prompts, todos, questions and prose files, where models mis-spell the hex and corrupt the text (anthropics/claude-code#83033).

guardSimplified.title: Guard Traditional Chinese
guardSimplified.description: auto: while your own words are Traditional Chinese, refuse writes that put Simplified-only characters (发, 这, 说) or zh-CN software terms (服務器, 默認, 視頻) into a file, and name the zh-TW forms. Terms the file already uses are allowed. A file already in Simplified, or named for zh-CN, zh-SG or zh-Hans, is left alone, and sending the same call again lets an intended quote through. on: always. off: never.

guardHeredoc.title: Guard unquoted heredocs
guardHeredoc.description: Refuse a Bash command whose heredoc delimiter is unquoted (<<EOF) while its body holds ${...}, $(...), backticks or backslash escapes, which the shell expands before the text is written. Sending the same command again lets an intended expansion through.

guardGlossary.title: Guard the project glossary
guardGlossary.description: When the repository's CLAUDE.md has a table with a column of terms to use and a column of wordings to avoid (| Use | Avoid | or | 用語 | 避免 |), refuse a file write that brings in an avoided wording and name the term to use. Wordings the file already uses are allowed, and sending the same call again lets an intended one through. Does nothing in a project without such a table.

carryOver.title: Carry over unfinished tasks
carryOver.description: Keep what the session's task list (TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, TodoWrite) leaves open, per repository, and offer it above the prompt in the next session there, or in the conversation a /clear starts: continue puts the items in the prompt box, dismiss forgets them. Only items made with Claude's task tools count; Claude Code leaves those off for Claude 5.x, so while this is on tessera sets CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 for the session unless you set that variable yourself.

resumeAfterLimit.title: Resume after limits
resumeAfterLimit.description: Off by default. When a usage limit stops a turn, queue a prompt that continues the work a minute after the limit resets; anything you type first cancels it.
